adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, the credential-sync path does `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, { method: "POST", body: new URLSearchParams({ calcomUserId, appSlug }) })` with no auth header/signature/secret included. Meanwhile the inbound webhook (`apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`) explicitly authenticates via `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` in a header. So the finding is accurate: the outbound sync request, as implemented in the diff, provides no built-in way for the receiving app to verify the caller is the Cal.com instance (unless the receiver uses out-of-band controls). This is a concrete, diff-grounded security/integration completeness concern, though it’s presented as “customize payload based on what your endpoint requires,” so it’s more an incomplete design than a provable functional break.
